papers.title: Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
papers.problem: Live video generators must run in few steps, but errors pile up and the picture drifts over time.
papers.fix: A four-step streaming model trained with Progressive Forcing beat recent streaming baselines and stayed stable through 30-minute racing rollouts.
papers.practicalUseCase: Live video can follow simple shape inputs without drifting, so try it for interactive simulations.
papers.limitation: The test showed stable output for 30 minutes of racing video only, so other scenes remain unproven.

papers.title: Let Samples Sing in Chorus: Mitigating Spurious Correlations via Cross-view Consensus
papers.problem: AI models often copy shortcuts in the data, so they fail on small groups of examples.
papers.fix: CHORD compares several views of each example to remove shortcuts and improved weakest-group accuracy on seven benchmarks.
papers.practicalUseCase: Your model may look accurate overall yet fail on rare groups, so check group-level accuracy before you ship.
papers.limitation: The paper reports gains on seven benchmarks only, so results on other data and tasks are unknown.

papers.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
papers.problem: Self-improving AI agents often stall, and methods trade wins across papers with no clear reason.
papers.fix: Across seven methods and six models, noisy scores picked good changes no better than random chance.
papers.practicalUseCase: Small score gaps between agent methods are often luck, so rerun each test before you trust a ranking.
papers.limitation: The study covers seven evolution methods and six models, so other setups may behave differently.

papers.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
papers.problem: Video AI that watches a live stream usually answers each user request alone, without acting on its own.
papers.fix: ALIVE learns when to speak, ask, or stay silent, and scored highest among compared models on four benchmarks and FSI-Bench.
papers.practicalUseCase: Video assistants can now watch, warn, and ask follow-up questions, so consider them for live monitoring tasks.
papers.limitation: It won only against the compared models, and the authors built one of the tests themselves.
